commits.message: fix(bench): support Windows paths and shorten routine benchmark runs
fix(bench): generate valid slugs for scaling fixtures
chore: add workspace lint, formatting, and Git hooks
feat(examples): move pages into a single local workspace app
fix(core): preserve resource CRUD types in the SDK
feat(core): add MCP tools and shared transport helpers
feat(deployment): add Vercel configuration and update server preset for deployment builds
fix(client): honor custom action paths and HTTP methods (#5)
docs: declare GET for the custom public page lookup
fix(bench): declare GET methods for compiler actions (#8)
feat(client): generate browser-safe contracts automatically with Vite
chore: add MIT license and publish license metadata (#9)
fix(core): use single items array for resource list results (#11)
fix(cli): resolve recursive client schema references (#12)
perf(cli): deduplicate repeated client contract types (#14)
fix(deps): remediate Socket dependency vulnerability alerts (#15)
fix(bench): register HTTP input benchmark as GET (#16)
